body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received photos ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add one-tap sharing of received files, with staggered downloads when batch sharing is unavailable.
>• Track files already handed over and cover sharing, failures, and downloads with tests.
>• Experimental test copy; do not merge.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD UI["Save all button"] --> Select["Select received files"] --> Ready{"Files ready?"} Ready -- "yes" --> Capable{"Batch shareable?"} Ready -- "no" --> Message["Status toast"] Capable -- "yes" --> Share["Share sheet"] --> Handed["Handed IDs"] Capable -- "no" --> Downloads["Staggered downloads"] --> Handed Share -- "failure: next tap" --> Downloads ```
High-Level Assessment

>The separate selection and handoff module keeps browser-specific behavior testable while preserving the user gesture needed for sharing. Bundling fallback files into an archive would reduce download prompts but add packaging work and change the files users receive; the current approach fits this feature.

>Wire Save all into the browser UI > >

>Implement received-file batch saving > >

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (4) 📎 Requirement gaps (1)
1. Save all says saved before downloads run 📎 Requirement gap
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() in createSaveAll displays Saved ${ready.length} before attempting any downloads and logs
>thrown download() calls only to console.warn. In a download-mode batch, browser prompts or
>blocks can leave the claimed result unverified, while a thrown attempt leaves its photo eligible for
>retry on a later tap without telling the person a retry is needed.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R51-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/136/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR51-R54) > >```diff >+ toast(`Saved ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >In download mode, `createSaveAll` reports `Saved N` before attempting downloads and does not visibly report attempts that throw. The page cannot confirm what the browser retained, and a failed photo remains eligible for retry without telling the person. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-56] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[65-73] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[177-193] >- tests/two-browser.mjs[279-284] > >## Recommended Fix >Replace the up-front `Saved` toast with downloading-style progress wording. Continue the batch while counting successful `download()` calls and failures, keep `handed.add` only for successful calls, and show a final status that distinguishes downloads started from failed attempts and visibly notes when a retry is needed. Do not describe attempts as files saved or imply the page has confirmed what the browser retained. Update the affected test assertions to match the new wording and failure status. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4862feba-2250-49b7-b581-e2f6c74d6b3f?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4862feba-2250-49b7-b581-e2f6c74d6b3f)

2. A photo can download twice during Save all 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() downloads every entry in its initial ready snapshot without checking whether that photo
>was handed over during a download gap. If someone taps an individual photo while Save all is
>waiting, save() downloads and marks it handed over, but the batch later downloads it again.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R52-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/136/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR52-R54) > >```diff >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual-photo tap during a Save all download gap can download a photo already queued in the batch, causing a duplicate. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[52-55] >- web/index.html[326-328] >## Recommended Fix >Coordinate individual saves with the active batch, and recheck each PID against the shared handed-over set immediately before starting its batch download. Keep the batch count consistent with files actually attempted. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/d6ae85ee-6d0e-4b86-be49-2573183b3d1d?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/d6ae85ee-6d0e-4b86-be49-2573183b3d1d)
View medium (3)
3. An open share sheet triggers download mode 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() treats every non-cancellation rejection from share(list) as a failed share sheet and sets
>downloadNext, even when an individual-photo share is already open. In that case the concurrent
>Save all share rejects with InvalidStateError, so the next Save all tap downloads the batch
>instead of offering the share sheet.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R42-45]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/136/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR42-R45) > >```diff >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >+ if (e?.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled: nothing happens, the photos stay available >+ downloadNext = true; >+ return toast('Couldn’t open the share sheet. Tap Save all again to download'); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual share already in progress makes a concurrent Save all share reject, incorrectly switching the next Save all tap into download mode. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[326-328] >- web/saveall.js[38-45] >## Recommended Fix >Use shared in-progress state for individual and batch shares. Do not classify a concurrent-share rejection as a failure that requests download fallback; give the person a visible retry message without launching another share or download. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/5cca1be3-e2bc-4528-ac40-0777739659c9?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/5cca1be3-e2bc-4528-ac40-0777739659c9)
4. A stalled share blocks every retry 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() keeps busy true until the promise returned by share(list) settles, with no recovery path
>for a promise that remains pending. If a browser or share target never settles that promise, every
>subsequent Save all tap only says “Still saving,” even though the received files remain available.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R41-42]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/136/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR41-R42) > >```diff >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that stays pending holds the Save all guard indefinitely, preventing further attempts. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[27-33] >- web/saveall.js[39-56] >## Recommended Fix >Provide an explicit recovery path for a stalled share that does not require awaiting that promise. Track the original operation so a late resolution cannot incorrectly mark photos handed over or start a duplicate batch; keep the initial navigator.share call inside the user's tap. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/de6484a6-8fe3-486b-a127-77e7f8822cff?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/de6484a6-8fe3-486b-a127-77e7f8822cff)
5. Verifying photos vanish from the count 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch() counts still-arriving photos only while their IDs remain in incoming, although
>transfer completion removes that entry before asynchronous fingerprint verification finishes. A tap
>during verification sees the photo in neither incoming nor files, so Save all can say “Nothing
>new to save” or omit it from the still-arriving count until verification completes.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R16-17]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/136/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR16-R17) > >```diff >+ let arriving = 0; >+ for (const fid of incoming.keys()) if (!fid.startsWith('thumb:') && !files.has(fid)) arriving++; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A full photo disappears from Save all's arriving count between receipt of its final chunk and completion of fingerprint verification. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[205-211] >- web/index.html[224-239] >- web/saveall.js[16-18] >## Recommended Fix >Retain or separately track a full-file transfer through verification, then remove that in-progress state once verification succeeds or fails. Include that state in the still-arriving count without treating its bytes as ready to save. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
